notes.title: Sands of Time DLC – Development Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]It has been a busy stretch of production, and we want to take a moment to share where things stand with the [i]Sands of Time[/i] DLC for [b]Elleria: Book I[/b].[/p][p]The DLC has grown into something much larger than originally envisioned—expanding the world of Elleria with new lore, cinematic moments, and original music. A great deal of work is going into ensuring the [b]fantasy atmosphere remains deep, immersive, and true to the tone of the main game.[/b][/p][p]Here’s what’s been happening:[/p][list][*][p][b]Visuals & Cinematics:[/b] We’ve been creating new renders, animations, especially environmental ones and vision sequences that will bring the desert setting and its mysteries to life.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Music & Atmosphere:[/b] A fully new soundtrack is in progress, tailored to match both the awe-inspiring and ominous tones of the story. As always, being very firm about music and believing it contributes heavily to overall atmosphere and story, Sands of Time currently stands above 20 soundtracks tailored for it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Narrative & Lore:[/b] The [i]Sands of Time[/i] storyline expands on themes of fate, time, and forgotten powers tying directly into Eliot’s journey and what awaits beyond Book I.[/p][/*][/list][p]This DLC is not just an “add-on”—it’s part of a larger vision leading toward [b]Book II[/b], giving both long-time players and newcomers more reasons to dive deeper into Elleria’s universe. Rest assured we're currently working [b]way[/b] over the clock, to deliver this as fast as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]And now for something special we’re sharing one of the [i]Sands of Time[/i] OST tracks:[/p][p]🎶 [b]Vaerith – The Veiled Daughter[/b][/p][p]This piece captures her presence perfectly: majestic, inevitable, and quietly awe-inspiring. It’s one of our personal favorites, and we can’t wait for you to hear it![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="CTxoohjuDS8;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: v1.5 Update – The Wheel Turns Again
notes.content:
[h2]📜 v1.5 – [i]Wheel of Fate[/i] \[DLC Update][/h2][p][b]🔹 The story continues with [i]The Wheel Unbroken[/i][/b]
– New regions. New choices. Death itself has taken notice... and now demands an audience.
– New achievements added!
– The Prologue and Chapter II – Part II have been polished: grammar fixes, sentence rewrites, and a full pass over earlier chapters. Everything now reads smoother than ever.
– Fixed an issue where Prologue images refused to load properly (they’ve been disciplined).
– The Music Room has been updated with [i]Wheel of Fate[/i] tracks for your listening pleasure.
– Cloud Save support is now live![/p][p][b]🔹 Miscellaneous Fixes & Improvements[/b]
– Squashed a few typos. The Blight keeps attacking... but it won’t win.
– Fixed missing achievements. The Inquisition concluded their investigation—the culprit was set on fire. (By divine order, of course. We consider this a learning moment.)
– Even more new music tracks have been added!
– Codex updates and fresh entries are in. Paladins are now allowed to borrow sacred scrolls and learn more about the world—just don’t forget to return them after reading![/p][p][b]📘 Codex Highlights[/b]
[b]World Lore:[/b]
– The Aspects, The Gods, The Chosen, The Stone Tongue, and The Holy Order of The One.
[b]Places:[/b]
– Numerous new entries on key regions across Elleria.[/p]

notes.title: Wheel of Fate v1.4 – The Dead Remember & Chains of the Divine
notes.content:
[b]v1.4 – Wheel of Fate [DLC][/b]
[i]“In shadows and steel, we stand unbroken—even as the Blight claws at our gates.”[/i]

[b]Hearken, noble Paladins of The One![/b] [b]You[/b], the steel-clad vanguard of our sacred Order, are called once more to purge the corruption that festers across Elleria.

[list]
[*] The Blight Unmasked: This is no mere pestilence—it writhes with malevolent sentience, seeking to sunder hope itself. Rally your faith and your blade!
[/list]

[list]
[*] Immersive Battle Hymns & Divine Echoes: New SFX and soundtracks to fortify your spirit in the darkest hours.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Heraldic Interface Overhaul: A refreshed splash-screen and main menu, emblazoned with our Order’s sigil, to remind you of your sacred duty before every campaign.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [u]Steam Deck Sanctification[/u]: Elleria’s crusade is now Steam Deck Verified—wield your Deck in the field, and let no terrain nor torrent of Blight impede your quest!
[/list]

[list]
[*] 19 Knightly Achievements: Just prove your devotion to The One as you fight in His name—collect these annals of our Order! The One wills it!
[/list]

[list]
[*] Errata Exterminated & Minor Faults Purged: Under The One’s unerring gaze, no typo or bug escapes the Inquisition’s judgment.
[/list]

[h1]Note on Act III – Rebuilding Human Realms:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A minor disturbance in the Veil occurred during Act IV’s crafting. The Gods themselves have conspired with the Blight—sending their twisted agents to assail our Order. Yet, thanks to the Inquisition’s far-reaching intelligence on these blasphemous acts, we have struck before their plan could fully unfurl. Should any choice falter, you will receive an automatic prompt to reaffirm your last vow before the Act’s end. Let no shadow of doubt sunder your resolve!
[/list]

[h2]BONUS – Inquisition Report: Lyria the Elf[/h2]

[u]To: Emissary Eliot, Divine Herald of The One
From: Scout-Commander Seren Valaris, Inquisition Branch, Southern Watch
Subject: Intelligence on “Lyria the Elf”[/u]

Divine Emissary,

While monitoring Paladin morale along the southern front, our mages of subtle hearing recorded repeated campfire murmurs invoking the name of a certain elf—spoken with reverence and hope. Cross-referencing these whispers with our field reports, we confirm that Lyria the Elf has become a beacon of courage among your knights, believed capable of turning the tide against the Blight.

On receipt of Your directive, the Inquisition dispatched operatives to scour every sanctuary, wood, and ruin across Elleria. Though she vanished from known realms over half a year ago, this will not stop our pursuers—no glen shall hide her, no fortress deter us, for none escape the vigilance of our Order.

We await Your further command and stand ready to deliver this elf into the sanctum’s custody—or to call upon her valor in our sacred crusade.

By The One’s will,
Scout-Commander Seren Valaris
Inquisition Branch, Southern Watch

[b]Stand ready, Paladins. The Wheel of Fate turns—and with The One’s light, we shall endure.[/b]

notes.title: Patchageddon: Renderer Wars & More! v1.3.3
notes.content:
[h1]Renderer Selector & The Blight Cleansing Patch[/h1]

Gather around Paladins!

Today’s patching spree is all about stability, bug-smashing, and putting an end to the renderer corruption The Blight has been spreading across your systems! 

🧙 [b]New: Graphics Mode Selector[/b]

On first launch (or after resetting Preferences), the game now asks which arcane rendering method you'd like to trust.

[b]Your choices:[/b]

[list]
[*] Auto – Let the Sanctum divine the best choice.
[*] ANGLE – Blessed path for modern GPUs.
[*] OpenGL 2 (GL2) – For older relics that still endure.
[*] OpenGL (GL) – Ancient fallback—only if all else fails.
[/list]

If you've encountered black screens, crashes, or strange artifacting, this selector might be your salvation.

📜 [b]Textbox Opacity Purification[/b]
Some players reported crashes when adjusting textbox opacity.
Turns out The Blight had its claws in the UI.
We’ve exorcised the issue. The setting now initializes properly and no longer causes chaos.

🛠️ [b]General Cleansing & Safety Rites[/b]

[b]Removed lingering renderer code corrupted by the Old Code.[/b]

Ensured that all renderer choices are preserved safely. No more overwriting your sacred save files.

✅ [b]This patch should:[/b]

[list]
[*] Eliminate crashes caused by incompatible or cursed graphics renderers.
[*] Resolve opacity-related exceptions haunting the Preferences screen.
[*] Make startup smoother for all chosen warriors of Elleria.
[/list]


🧹 [b]IMPORTANT[/b]:
[u]If you played a previous version, delete your persistent data and reinstall the game to fully purge any lingering corruption.[/u]

[i]The Blight remembers. But now, so do we.[/i]


[i]"The Blight spreads no more… for now."[/i]

notes.title: v1.3.2 [HOTFIX] – The Renderer Rebellion
notes.content:
[h1]v1.3.2 – Wheel of Fate [Hotfix][/h1]

Some players encountered a rare but critical crash after naming their character, caused by:

[u]TypeError: '<=' not supported between instances of 'NoneType' and 'float'[/u]

[b]Why did it happen?[/b]

[i]This occurs only on specific setups where a combination of GPU drivers + Ren'Py’s default (gl3/ANGLE) renderer + certain UI transforms causes instability — particularly on Steam Deck and newer GPUs.[/i]

[b]Fixes in this hotfix:
[/b]
[list]
[*] 🔧 Renderer fallback updated to use gl2 and a stable 60 FPS cap. 
[/list]

This improves compatibility for Steam Deck, Linux, and modern graphics cards. 
No performance impact for players who weren’t affected.

If you’re still experiencing issues, you can also manually launch the game with this in your Steam launch options: 

--renderer gl2 --framerate 60

notes.title: Something is cooking!
notes.content:
[b]No, we haven’t forgotten about Elleria.[/b]

While my focus and priorities have shifted towards other matters, steady progress has been made on the first DLC: War Table.

An update is coming soon, starting with the first batch of content— first Chapters 1 and 2 have been attacked without mercy. This merciless attack includes grammar corrections, structural improvements, and overall polish. Every single render, from the beginning to the end, has been reprocessed for better visual quality and to fix overly dark scenes. While this may come with increase in game size, I'd believe it is worth it!

The initial War Table release will feature:

[list]
[*] The Council Reforms
[*] 
[*] Demonic Negotiations
[*] 
[*] Rebuilding the Human Realms
[/list]

Choices. Consequences. Branching paths. And oh yes, I've also left a render of character rework on Eliot. Consider it an early sneak-peek. 

But enough teasing for now. Here’s a short cinematic opening from the DLC to set the tone.

notes.title: Chapter III Ending & Notes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101741/ab7c6cae893831d61c670498096b501fc7dea308.png[/img]

Phew! This has been quite the workload. The longest update so far, and while I originally planned to end it sooner, I decided not to cut any content. This ended up being more than I initially anticipated—but it's done now!

With that said, [b]Chapter III is officially wrapped up![/b] I hope this update will give you more than the usual one-hour playthrough. The patch notes are listed below.

There's not much else to say for now. I'll see you again soon with the start of Chapter IV. On that note, we're getting closer to the end of Book 1 of Elleria—just Chapters 4 and 5 to go, and then it's a wrap!

More info on that, as well as what comes next, will be coming soon.

Till next time!

Before leaving the patch notes below, along with the new changes and/or additions as always. A small note that I'm listening and watching. 

Especially for your feedbacks/suggestions and/or otherwise. The most noted one so far, that seems to be repeated is regarding the adult scenes... patience is a virtue, knowledge doesn't come overnight. But you'll find one new adult scene in this update, one where I tried to improve upon such scenes. As much as time granted me anyway.
